dimensions.assessment: Affects federal wildlife personnel, state and local governments, tribal agencies, and private landowners adjacent to refuges who partner or request assistance.
dimensions.evidence: engage in partnerships and collaborations with-- (i) Federal, State, Tribal, and local governments; (ii) nongovernmental institutions; (iii) nonprofit organizations; and (iv) private individuals

dimensions.assessment: Provides targeted operational support, strike teams, and financial or technical assistance for managing invasive species threats.
dimensions.evidence: establish at least 1 invasive species strike team within each region of the United States Fish and Wildlife Service

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations of $10,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2033.
dimensions.evidence: There is authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary to carry out this section $10,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2033.

dimensions.assessment: Provides statutory authority for an existing Department of the Interior program with specific interagency reporting and database coordination rules.
dimensions.evidence: This bill provides statutory authority for the Invasive Species Strike Team program carried out by the National Wildlife Refuge System

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes funding and program operations across a seven-year span from fiscal year 2027 through 2033.
dimensions.evidence: for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2033

missing_information: Exact long-term ecological or economic savings resulting from invasive species eradication.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill authorizes $10,000,000 annually for fiscal years 2027 through 2033 for the National Wildlife Refuge System Invasive Species Strike Team Program, impacting federal land management and participating partners.
